method: Official Microsoft pages actually opened as text; no competitor playthrough or accessibility certification claimed.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 112: UI navigation
sources.observed: Consistent order, predictable focus and navigation across game menus.
sources.projectInference: Keep eight entry points stable and return ordinary details to their initiating context.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 114: UI context
sources.observed: Communicate purpose and expected effect before interaction; context changes should be player initiated or explained.
sources.projectInference: Distinguish view/draft/execute, keep the one current activity visible, and do not restart or replace it when inspecting another page.

limits: Layout, bytes, periods and one-screen scope are project decisions. Only fixed1440x900 Chromium functional verification in R1; no compatibility or environment matrix.
